About the job
Limmatwerk is a Swiss industrial group active in building technology, precision components and water treatment. With 6,800 employees in 31 countries and net sales of CHF 2.3 billion, we are listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

We are looking for our next Head of Group Tax to lead the tax function from our headquarters in Zurich. You will report directly to the Group CFO.

Your responsibilities
- Lead the Group Tax team of nine tax professionals in Zurich, Frankfurt and Singapore
- Own the group's tax strategy, the tax risk management framework and the tax control framework
- Steer the implementation of the OECD Pillar Two rules, including the GloBE Information Return and the qualified domestic minimum top-up taxes in Switzerland and in more than 20 other jurisdictions
- Oversee transfer pricing policies, documentation (Master File, Local Files) and the Country-by-Country Report
- Manage tax audits and tax disputes and maintain relationships with the Swiss and foreign tax authorities
- Be responsible for income tax reporting under IFRS (IAS 12), including deferred taxes and uncertain tax positions
- Advise on the tax structuring of M&A transactions, reorganisations and group financing
- Report to the Audit Committee on tax risks twice a year

Your profile
- Swiss certified tax expert, German Steuerberater or an equivalent qualification, plus a degree in law or economics
- At least 15 years of experience in international tax, of which 8+ years in a leadership role in a multinational group or a Big Four firm
- Strong knowledge of Swiss and German tax law and of international tax concepts
- Proven experience with Pillar Two implementation and transfer pricing
- Excellent command of English and German; French is an asset

What we offer
- A permanent position with a highly visible role in an international group
- Attractive compensation: base salary between CHF 210,000 and 245,000, annual bonus and long-term incentive plan
- Modern office at our headquarters in Zurich Oerlikon with one home-office day per week
- Six weeks of vacation and an attractive pension fund
- Relocation support for candidates moving to Switzerland

Please note that this role is based in Zurich. We do not consider remote set-ups from abroad or interim arrangements.
